defaults.method: The configured adapter evaluated its declared expectation against the bound subject.
defaults.scope: The recorded expectation and subject identity bound to this probe.
defaults.limit: Other behaviors, environments and future runs need their own evidence.

dry.method: The dry adapter emitted a controlled outcome to check UVE plumbing.
dry.scope: Receipt generation and evaluation for the controlled outcome.
dry.limit: This probe exercised a fixture and provides no live application or device evidence.

command.method: The command adapter ran the declared command in the bound workspace and compared the exit code and any required stdout marker.
command.scope: The checks actually performed by the declared command.

adb.method: The ADB adapter read the bound device property or executed the declared UI flow and recorded its assertions.
adb.scope: The device property or UI steps listed in the observation.
adb.limit: A focused package or visible element alone does not establish persistence, backend success or coverage of other screens.

adb_lifecycle.method: The lifecycle adapter observed the leased emulator as it started and recorded its state transitions.
adb_lifecycle.scope: The lifecycle steps observed for the bound emulator fixture.

application_health.method: The application health adapter checked the bound app and the configured UI and runtime health signals.
application_health.scope: The configured health signals observed for the bound app.

expo_metro.method: The Metro adapter requested the configured status endpoint and compared the returned status marker.
expo_metro.scope: The response from the configured development server status endpoint.
expo_metro.limit: A Metro status response alone does not establish that the intended bundle or screen loaded.

process_health.method: The process health adapter attempted a TCP connection to the configured endpoint.
process_health.scope: Listener reachability at the configured host and port.

engine_meta.method: The engine adapter ran the declared UVE self-check.
engine_meta.scope: The UVE engine contract exercised by that self-check.

deep_flow.method: The deep-flow adapter executed the declared fixture plan and evaluated the recorded cases and invariants for its configured depth.
deep_flow.scope: The recorded cases, trace edges and cleanup assertions defined by the bound flow.

ai_lab_training_quality.method: UVE projected the required checks from the AI Lab quality receipt.
ai_lab_training_quality.scope: The checks and training candidate recorded in the source quality receipt.

probe_outcomes.passed: The recorded evidence satisfied the declared probe expectation.
probe_outcomes.failed: The probe recorded a failed check for the bound subject.
probe_outcomes.not_verified: The probe did not establish a result for the declared expectation.

probe_reasons.lease_denied: The required resource lease was unavailable, so the adapter did not execute.
probe_reasons.identity_unstable: The bound identity changed or could not be confirmed during the probe.
probe_reasons.manifest_mismatch: The engine could not confirm that the frozen verification configuration remained stable.
probe_reasons.binding_missing: The probe lacked a required binding for its evidence.
probe_reasons.adapter_error: The adapter could not complete its declared execution or capture usable evidence.

gate_outcomes.approved: The supplied receipts satisfied the gate policy for the recorded subject.
gate_outcomes.rejected: The gate policy rejected the supplied evidence for this decision.
gate_outcomes.not_verified: The supplied evidence was insufficient to establish the gate decision.

gate_reasons.requirements_met: Every required probe passed and the evidence satisfied the gate checks.
gate_reasons.engine_degraded: The gate could not run while UVE reported a degraded engine.
gate_reasons.gate_manifest_unavailable: UVE could not load the gate policy.
gate_reasons.evaluator_not_independent: The evaluator was missing or was also recorded as a repair actor.
gate_reasons.bundle_unavailable: UVE could not load the trusted manifest bundle.
gate_reasons.bundle_mismatch: The supplied bundle hash differs from the trusted bundle.
gate_reasons.gate_policy_mismatch: The selected gate policy differs from the policy in the trusted bundle.
gate_reasons.invalid_probe_receipt: A supplied receipt failed UVE receipt validation.
gate_reasons.probe_bundle_mismatch: A supplied probe was recorded under a different manifest bundle.
gate_reasons.probe_configuration_changed: A supplied probe's recorded configuration differs from the current configuration.
gate_reasons.probe_identity_changed: A supplied probe's recorded subject differs from the current subject.
gate_reasons.probe_binding_unavailable: UVE could not revalidate a supplied probe against its current profile.
gate_reasons.snapshot_proof_missing: A passing probe omitted its required snapshot proof.
gate_reasons.delivery_proof_missing: A passing probe omitted its required runtime delivery proof.
gate_reasons.duplicate_probe: The supplied set contains more than one receipt for a probe.
gate_reasons.required_probes_missing: The gate did not receive every required probe receipt.
gate_reasons.flow_replay_mismatch: The recorded flow could not be reproduced from its linked evidence under the current policy.
gate_reasons.required_observation_mismatch: A required observation value was missing or differed from the gate policy.
gate_reasons.subject_identity_mismatch: The supplied probes are bound to different subject identities.
gate_reasons.required_probe_not_verified: At least one required probe returned not_verified.
gate_reasons.required_probe_identity_unstable: At least one required probe recorded unstable subject identity.
gate_reasons.subject_assertion_failed: At least one required probe recorded a subject assertion failure.
gate_reasons.probe_execution_failed: A required probe did not pass and the supplied evidence did not establish a subject assertion failure.
gate_reasons.witness_contract_failed: The independent witness could not pass the candidate contract tests.

blocked_method: UVE stopped before adapter execution because it could not obtain a required lease.
fixture_limit: This outcome was produced in an explicit fixture mode and supplies no live application or device evidence.
gate_method: UVE evaluated the supplied receipts against the gate policy and checked their subject, bindings and evaluator where applicable.
gate_limit: The decision covers only the declared gate requirements for the linked subject and receipts.
